$comment: Where the Texas Education Agency's PDF (the law in force) and the machine-readable copy differ, the PDF wins. `wording`: a statement whose wording the State Board has changed since the copy was made. `added`: a statement the copy lost. Each entry is used only if the builder finds its text in the PDF, in the section of its grade; build-en-tx.js then also counts the lettered and numbered lines of every grade in the PDF against the registry.
